messages:
Alex Chen: Quick notes from today's check-in with AcmeRetail — capturing a few product asks + pain points for triage. main points: slow embedding refresh for daily ingest (~30m lag), generation hallucinations on product descriptions after schema change, customer asks for okta SSO + SCIM, and they'd love a dedicated rollout window for model upgrades. shared a few failed prompt examples.
Maria K: adding to the CS feedback tracker now. can you paste the concrete prompt/log snippets here or in the sheet? link: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/1AcmeFeedback
Alex Chen: pasted 2 short examples below:
```
User prompt: "Summarize product X features"
Response: "Product X includes features A, B, and C but omits pricing and uses outdated sku names."
```
and the embedding delay: "Ingest job completed at 02:10, embeddings available at 02:40 — customers expect <10m."
Samir Patel: thanks. renewal check: Acme's enterprise renewal is in 6 weeks, current NPS down a bit. which items are blockers vs nice-to-have? SSO/SCIM sounds high-impact for renewal.
Emily (PM): agree SSO is high-impact. hallucinations on descriptions are product quality risk — I want concrete repro steps + a small eval set we can run. can you (Alex) add 5 failing prompts to the tracker and mark severity? i'll scope quick mitigation (prompt-safety rules + failback to older vetted model) if repro is clear.
Alex Chen: done — added 5 prompts and marked 3 as high severity. also added an ingestion timeline and current retry/noise logs. flagged SSO request as "sales blocker" in the sheet. cc @Emily (PM)
Maria K: re onboarding status — they finished platform training last week, but reported confusion on model pinning rollouts. Can we schedule a short enablement session: 30m walkthrough of rollouts + canary config?
Emily (PM): yes — i'll take the enablement session. propose Tue 10am next week. also will prioritize a small eval job to reproduce hallucinations; can engineering spin up a short-run canary? tagging @Samir for capacity.
Samir Patel: we have room to run a 12-hour canary on dedicated infra next Tue. i'll coordinate with eng-runtime to get a pinned model variant. please add exact eval inputs to the tracker so we can provision correctly.
OnboardBot: Reminder: "AcmeRetail onboarding — follow-up enablement scheduled" created for Tue 10:00. Add agenda items and meeting notes to the sheet.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone — i'll update the tracker with agenda + example prompts. i'll also loop in the account exec for renewal discussion tomorrow. :thumbsup:
